verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that voicemail recordings can be downloaded via the API (a developer building block) and that call transcripts exist and can be deleted. Nothing documents voicemail transcription or automatic delivery of voicemails to email or chat, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a founder, voicemails are transcribed and delivered to email or chat so I can read them without dialing in
